items.lang|kaleidoscope_cookery|kaleidoscope_c: Cooking with the Stockpot
To cook with the stockpot, place it on a valid heat source.
First, add a soup base to the stockpot.
Next, add the required ingredients.
After adding all of the required ingredients, cover the stockpot with a stockpot lid.
Then, wait for a moment...
...and remove the lid.
The dish is ready!
Cooking with the Wok
To cook with the wok, place it on a valid heat source.
First, add some oil to the wok.
Next, add the required ingredients.
After adding all of the required ingredients, use the kitchen shovel to start stir-frying!
Then, after enough stirs and waiting for a moment...
...the dish is done!
Placing Steamers
To cook with steamers, place it on a valid heat source.
Then, place more steamers on top of existing ones to stack them higher...
...and higher and higher!
However, a single heat source can only provide heat for up to 8 steamers...
...so, be mindful of its limits!
Cooking with Steamers
From the top, insert ingredients into the steamer.
Steamers already containing ingredients can also be directly stacked.
After placing them, right click to cover the steamer and start steaming.
